meta.name: System
meta.description: Phone system root object, placed in Setting, containing settings modules and applications through contains relations. Supports querying and setting airplane mode; the responses of individual wireless modules are defined by explicit dependencies. System does not duplicate module state or modify the simulation clock.

airplane_mode.description: Whether airplane mode is requested for the phone. Wireless modules respond through their explicit dependencies rather than through duplicated state on this object.

get_airplane_mode.description: Return whether airplane mode is currently requested without changing system or module state.

airplane_mode.description: Whether airplane mode is currently requested.

set_airplane_mode.description: Set whether airplane mode is requested. Wireless modules respond separately through explicit dependencies. Invalid input is rejected and leaves the setting unchanged.
